answers.q1: Yarn 1 (classic) workspaces monorepo, pinned as yarn@1.22.22 with Node >= 18. Install dependencies from the repo root with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:app --watch=false  (CI runs `yarn test:app`; `yarn test` and plain `yarn test:app` start Vitest in watch mode. `yarn test:all` runs typecheck, lint, prettier and tests together.)
answers.q4: yarn install && yarn test:other && yarn test:code && yarn test:typecheck  (these are the three steps in .github/workflows/lint.yml. test:other is `prettier --list-different` on css/scss/json/md/html/yml. test:code is `eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .`. test:typecheck is `tsc`.)
answers.q5: Don't edit these by hand: yarn.lock (managed by yarn), node_modules/, build/, dist/, dev-dist/, coverage/, packages/*/dist and packages/*/build (build outputs, deleted by `yarn rm:build`), packages/excalidraw/types and public/workbox (generated, listed in .eslintignore), and examples/**/public. The translated locale files packages/excalidraw/locales/*.json other than en.json are synced from Crowdin, so edit only en.json (the source in crowdin.yml). I did not run anything to confirm which of these are present in this checkout.

q1.reason: Yarn classic with `yarn install` from the repo root matches the accept criterion.

q2.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false` is an explicitly accepted one-shot form, and the extra detail about CI and test:all is correct.

q3.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` is equivalent to the accepted form, since the flag order doesn't matter and it targets only that file.

q4.reason: It lists test:other, test:code and test:typecheck, exactly what lint.yml runs, with correct descriptions.

q5.reason: It names yarn.lock, build output dirs (build/, dist/, dev-dist/) and the non-en locale files with en.json as the only hand-edited one, and contains nothing that matches a REJECT item.
